svg.title: Known-best packing of 292 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=292 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete b637e6c rational centre/half-angle certificates in Evan Daniel's format, centres in [0, S]^2, read exactly from the retained source files, each held to the source's own Witness/v2 corner file of the same packing. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=292 known best: side ~ 17.59001644 (certified upper bound)
